//
// MonoKernel K2 (gfx1030, mono_k2_rdna2): the whole Qwen4Exp (Flash-Next)
// FFN block of one decoder layer
// for a batch of M <= 24 rows (any mix of tokens: the block
// is per token) in ONE persistent launch. It replaces the ~21 (M <= 8) / ~28
// (M > 8) kernels between the attention all-reduce and the FFN all-reduce;
// both all-reduces stay outside.
//
//   P1  HC combine (residual + attn_out * 2 sigmoid(inj/HC)) + grouped Gemma
//       RMSNorm -> res_out, xn                      (zero the scratch sums)
//   P2  HC down+inject GEMV  dai = xn . Wd^T        (K split)
//   P3  HC up GEMV + sigmoid + gated mean -> block_input; inj_out
//   P4  router GEMV (fp32 logits), shared-expert gate_up + silu, expert gate
//   P5  top-k (ballot radix select; every WG for M <= 8, one grid wave per row
//       above), local expert lists; routed gate_up as WG tiles; shared-expert
//       down; P5c SwiGLU
//   P6  routed down as WG tiles, * top-k weight
//   P7  out = fp16(shared + routed)                 (rank-local partial)
//
// Cross-WG sums use 64-bit fixed point with native integer atomics (Fx), so
// they are deterministic. Phases are separated by a grid barrier on a
// generation counter in global memory (agent-scope atomics, bounded wait, no
// grid.sync). A timed-out wait writes a sticky {code, phase, wg} record and
// each WG poisons caller-visible outputs before leaving; callers must fail
// stop on NaN. Opt-in MTP calls enqueue a same-stream control-header memset
// before the persistent launch so a prior timeout cannot latch later calls.
// The memset is a graph memset node, not an additional HIP kernel launch.
//
// Plain launch, one stream, capturable. The grid must be co-resident: the WG
// count is the residency cap derived from the code object (2 WGs per CU,
// 144 on a V620).
//
// Weight layouts are the ones the current decode path reads:
//   Wd [ND, HC*H], Wu [HC*H, R], router [E, H], se_w1 [2*Ise, H] (gate rows
//   then up rows), se_w2 [H, Ise], se_wg [H]  -- fp16, row-major
//   w13 [El, H/8, 2I] / w2 [El, I/8, H] uint32 (exllama-shuffled int4),
//   s13 / s2 [El, groups, N] fp16, z13 / z2 [El, groups, N/8] packed zeros
//   (moe_gptq_gemm_rdna2's layout, symmetric).

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

#include <torch/all.h>
#include <ATen/hip/HIPContext.h>
#include <c10/hip/HIPGuard.h>

#include <dlfcn.h>

#include <hip/hip_runtime.h>
#include <hip/hip_fp16.h>
#include <hsa/hsa_ext_amd.h>

#include "q_gemm_rdna2_common.cuh"
#include "qdq_4_rdna2.cuh"
#include "rdna_allreduce.cuh"

namespace mono_ffn {

constexpr int kThreads = 256;
constexpr int kWaves = kThreads / 32;
constexpr int kMaxM = 24;
constexpr int kTopK = 10;
constexpr int kMaxPairs = kMaxM * kTopK;
constexpr int kLocalE = 128;
constexpr int kHC = 4;
constexpr int kRowChunk = 8;
// E1 GDN decode (Qwen4Exp linear-attention layers, per TP rank).
constexpr int kGdnH = 4, kGdnHV = 12, kGdnK = 128, kGdnV = 128;
constexpr int kGdnQK = 2 * kGdnH * kGdnK;        // 1024 conv channels of q|k
constexpr int kGdnCD = kGdnQK + kGdnHV * kGdnV;  // 2560 conv channels (q|k|v)
constexpr int kGdnNQ = kGdnCD + kGdnHV * kGdnV;  // 4096 in_proj_qkvz rows
constexpr int kGdnNB = 2 * kGdnHV;               // 24 in_proj_ba rows (b|a)
constexpr int kGdnNI = kGdnNQ + kGdnNB;          // 4120 projected columns
constexpr int kGdnVD = kGdnHV * kGdnV;           // 1536 out_proj inputs

struct Ctrl {
  unsigned count;  // barrier arrivals
  unsigned gen;    // barrier generation
  int err_code;    // sticky: 0 ok, 1 barrier timeout
  int err_phase;
  int err_wg;
  int pad[3];
  unsigned long long ts[8];  // WG0 wall clock at entry and after each phase
  unsigned long long
      wg_done[10][256];  // per-WG end of phase work (debug); 7-9: P5 sub-steps
  int topk_id[kMaxPairs];  // WG0's routing of the last launch
  float topw[kMaxPairs];   // grid top-k weights (M > GTOPK_MIN)
  int gwork[4];            // dynamic row counters (GDN GEMVs), reset in P1
};

// Cross-WG fp32 reductions use 64-bit fixed point (2^-32 resolution, |v| <
// 2^31): gfx1030 has no global fp32 atomic add (atomicAdd(float*) is a CAS loop
// that retries under contention), but global_atomic_add_x2 is native. Integer
// sums are also order-independent, so the reductions are deterministic.
struct Fx {
  long long v;
  __device__ __forceinline__ Fx& operator=(float f) {
    v = __float2ll_rn(f * 4294967296.f);
    return *this;
  }
  __device__ __forceinline__ operator float() const {
    return __ll2float_rn(v) * (1.f / 4294967296.f);
  }
};
using ::atomicAdd;  // keep the HIP overloads visible next to the Fx one
__device__ __forceinline__ void atomicAdd(Fx* p, float f) {
  ::atomicAdd(reinterpret_cast<unsigned long long*>(&p->v),
              (unsigned long long)__float2ll_rn(f * 4294967296.f));
}

struct Params {
  // activations
  const half* res;  // [M, HC*H]
  const half* blk;  // [M, H]   attention output (after its all-reduce)
  const half* inj;  // [M, HC]  pending injection logits
  half* res_out;    // [M, HC*H]
  half* inj_out;    // [M, HC]
  half* out;        // [M, H]   rank-local FFN partial (pre all-reduce)
  // weights
  const half* norm_w;  // [HC*H]
  const half* wd;      // [ND, HC*H]
  const half* wu;      // [HC*H, R]
  const half* wr;      // [E, H] router
  const half* se_w1;   // [2*Ise, H]
  const half* se_w2;   // [H, Ise]
  const half* se_wg;   // [H]
  const uint32_t* w13;
  const half* w13_dense;  // MTP-only row-major [E, 2I, H]
  const half* s13;
  const uint32_t* z13;
  const uint32_t* w2;
  const half* w2_dense;  // MTP-only row-major [E, H, I]
  const half* s2;
  const uint32_t* z2;
  // workspace
  Ctrl* ctrl;
  Fx* dai;      // [M, ND]
  Fx* acc;      // [M, H]
  half* xn;     // [M, HC*H]
  half* bin;    // [M, H]
  Fx* logits;   // [M, E]
  Fx* se_g;     // [M, 2*Ise] shared-expert gate|up pre-activation
  Fx* se_gate;  // [M] expert-gate logit
  half* act;    // [M*topk, I]
  Fx* gu;       // [M*topk, 2I] routed gate|up sums (P5b tiles; cleared by P5c)
  // shapes
  int M, H, R, ND, E, Ise, I, group, expert_base, zero_offset;
  float eps;
  int prefetch;   // 1: waves 1..7 touch the next phase's weights while waiting
  int hc_only;    // K1: stop after P3 (block_input written to out via bin)
  int dense_mtp;  // MTP-only unquantized FP16 experts
  // E1 GDN mode: K1, then the linear-attention decode of the layer.
  int gdn;
  const half* g_wq;     // in_proj_qkvz [4096, H]
  const half* g_wba;    // in_proj_ba [24, H]
  const half* g_convw;  // conv1d [2560, 4]
  const half* g_convb;  // [2560] or null
  half* g_convs;        // conv state (slot, channel, 3) via strides, in place
  long g_cs_slot, g_cs_dim, g_cs_t;
  float* g_ssm;  // [slots, 12, 128 (V), 128 (K)] fp32, in place
  long g_ss_slot;
  int g_slots;
  const float* g_alog;  // [12]
  const float* g_dtb;   // [12]
  const half* g_normw;  // gated RMSNorm weight [128]
  const half* g_wo;     // out_proj [H, 1536]
  const int* g_sidx;    // state slot per row [M]
  float g_scale, g_eps;
  int g_sig;   // gate: 0 silu(z), 1 sigmoid(z)
  Fx* g_q;     // [M, 4120] projected q|k|v|z|b|a sums
  half* g_y;   // [M, 1536] gated-norm output
  half* g_st;  // [M, 1024, 3] new q|k conv state (deferred write)
  unsigned long long timeout_ticks;
  // Stage D: the FFN all-reduce (rdna_ar one-shot protocol) at the end of P7
  int ar_on;
  RdnaArDev ar;
  // Optional serve timing (workspace tail, see kStat*): per-width sums of the
  // phase times, the WG entry spread and the launch latency after a mark.
  unsigned long long* stats;
};

// Stats block: kStatRows rows of kStatCols uint64 per width M (1..24), then a
// scratch/tuning row {entry_min, entry_max, mark_t0, timing enabled,
// previous region end, barrier sleep, flags}. Row columns:
//  0 launches  1..7 phase P1..P7 (WG0)  8 last-first WG entry
//  9 first entry -> end  10 first entry -> WG0 entry
//  12 marked regions  13 marked region time  14 mark -> first entry
//  15 mark -> last entry  16 gaps  17 gap time (previous layer's region end
//  -> this region's start: the rest of the layer)  18/19 attention spans/time
//  (HC preamble + attention/GDN + its all-reduce)  20/21 HC preamble
//  spans/time (attention-side combine + mix)  22/23 attention all-reduce
//  calls/time (RowParallelLinear)  24/25 attention core (HC preamble end ->
//  attention + all-reduce end) on QSA layers, 26/27 on GDN layers (width
//  argument bit 5 = QSA)  28/29 shader-clock cycles / wall ticks over the
//  attention spans, 30/31 the same over the FFN regions (effective SCLK =
//  cycles / ticks x 100 MHz)  32..35 routing load: sums of local routed
//  pairs p, p^2, p x kernel ticks, kernel ticks^2. Wall-clock ticks (100 MHz).
// Tuning (0 = default): sleep = s_sleep argument while polling a barrier
// (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 127); flags bit 0 = skip the per-WG debug stores.
constexpr int kStatCols = 36;
constexpr int kTuneSleep = 5, kTuneFlags = 6, kFlagNoDebug = 1;
constexpr int kStatRows = kMaxM + 1;
constexpr int kStatWords = (kStatRows + 1) * kStatCols;

__device__ __forceinline__ float silu_f(float v) {
  return v / (1.f + __expf(-v));
}
__device__ __forceinline__ float sigmoid_f(float v) {
  return 1.f / (1.f + __expf(-v));
}

template <int N>
__device__ __forceinline__ void wave_sum(float (&a)[N]) {
#pragma unroll
  for (int m = 0; m < N; m++) {
#pragma unroll
    for (int off = 16; off >= 1; off >>= 1) a[m] += __shfl_xor(a[m], off);
  }
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------- barrier
__device__ __forceinline__ bool err_set(Ctrl* c) {
  return __hip_atomic_load(&c->err_code, __ATOMIC_RELAXED,
                           __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT) != 0;
}

__device__ __forceinline__ void poison_outputs(const Params& p, int wg, int tid,
                                               int G) {
  const half nan = __float2half(__int_as_float(0x7fc00000));
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < p.M * kHC * p.H; i += G * kThreads)
    p.res_out[i] = nan;
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < p.M * kHC; i += G * kThreads)
    p.inj_out[i] = nan;
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < p.M * p.H; i += G * kThreads)
    p.out[i] = nan;
}

// Returns false if this WG must leave (timeout here or elsewhere).
struct NoPrefetch {
  __device__ void operator()(int, uint32_t&, const volatile int*) const {}
};

// Returns false if this WG must leave (timeout here or elsewhere). Wave 0
// arrives and polls; waves 1..7 meanwhile run `prefetch(t, sink)` (t =
// thread index among them), which touches the weights of this WG's tasks in
// the next phase so they come from L2 / Infinity Cache instead of DRAM.
template <typename F = NoPrefetch>
__device__ __forceinline__ bool grid_barrier(const Params& p, int phase,
                                             int* s_flag, F prefetch = F()) {
  __shared__ volatile int s_rel;  // set once the barrier has released
  __builtin_amdgcn_fence(__ATOMIC_RELEASE, "agent");
  if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_rel = 0;
  __syncthreads();
  if (threadIdx.x < 32) {
    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
      const unsigned long long* tune =
          p.stats ? p.stats + (kMaxM + 1) * kStatCols : nullptr;
      const int sleep = tune ? (int)tune[kTuneSleep] : 0;
      const int flags = tune ? (int)tune[kTuneFlags] : 0;
      if (!(flags & kFlagNoDebug) && blockIdx.x < 256)
        p.ctrl->wg_done[phase - 1][blockIdx.x] = wall_clock64();
      Ctrl* c = p.ctrl;
      const unsigned G = gridDim.x;
      const unsigned g = __hip_atomic_load(&c->gen, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE,
                                           __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
      const unsigned arrived = __hip_atomic_fetch_add(
          &c->count, 1u, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
      int ok = 1;
      if (arrived == G - 1) {
        __hip_atomic_store(&c->count, 0u, __ATOMIC_RELAXED,
                           __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
        __hip_atomic_fetch_add(&c->gen, 1u, __ATOMIC_RELEASE,
                               __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
      } else {
        const unsigned long long t0 = wall_clock64();
        // Relaxed polling: an acquire load per poll would invalidate the
        // GL0/GL1 caches of WGs that are still working; the acquire fence
        // after the barrier orders the data.
        while (__hip_atomic_load(&c->gen, __ATOMIC_RELAXED,
                                 __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT) == g) {
          if (err_set(c)) {
            ok = 0;
            break;
          }
          if (wall_clock64() - t0 > p.timeout_ticks) {
            int zero = 0;
            if (__hip_atomic_compare_exchange_strong(
                    &c->err_code, &zero, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED, __ATOMIC_RELAXED,
                    __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT)) {
              c->err_phase = phase;
              c->err_wg = blockIdx.x;
            }
            ok = 0;
            break;
          }
          switch (sleep) {
            case 2:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(2);
              break;
            case 4:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(4);
              break;
            case 8:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(8);
              break;
            case 16:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(16);
              break;
            case 32:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(32);
              break;
            case 64:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(64);
              break;
            case 127:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(127);
              break;
            default:
              __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(1);
              break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (ok && err_set(c)) ok = 0;
      *s_flag = ok;
      s_rel = 1;
    }
  } else {
    uint32_t sink = 0;
    if (p.prefetch) prefetch(threadIdx.x - 32, sink, &s_rel);
    if (sink == 0x9e3779b9u && p.M < 0)
      p.ctrl->pad[1] = sink;  // keep the loads
  }
  __syncthreads();
  __builtin_amdgcn_fence(__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, "agent");
  if (!*s_flag) poison_outputs(p, blockIdx.x, threadIdx.x, gridDim.x);
  return *s_flag != 0;
}

// Touch [base, base + n16 * 16) in 16-byte units, strided over 224 threads.
__device__ __forceinline__ void touch16(const void* base, int n16, int t,
                                        uint32_t& sink,
                                        const volatile int* rel) {
  const uint4* q = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(base);
  for (int i = t; i < n16; i += 224) {
    if (*rel) return;  // released: stop, the next phase is on the clock
    const uint4 v = q[i];
    sink ^= v.x ^ v.w;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------- 4 fp16 weight rows x 8 act rows
// One wave, lanes striding K in 8-element (16 B) steps over [lo, hi). Each x
// load is shared by the 4 weight rows; acc[r][m] for x rows m0 .. m0+7.
__device__ __forceinline__ void rows4_dot(const half* const (&w)[4], int nw,
                                          const half* __restrict__ x, int ldx,
                                          int m0, int M, int lo, int hi,
                                          int lane, float (&acc)[4][8]) {
  for (int i0 = lo + lane; i0 < hi; i0 += 64) {
    uint4 wq[2][4];
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < 2; u++)
#pragma unroll
      for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
        wq[u][r] = (r < nw && i0 + 32 * u < hi)
                       ? reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(w[r])[i0 + 32 * u]
                       : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < 2; u++) {
      const int i = i0 + 32 * u;
      if (i >= hi) break;
#pragma unroll
      for (int m = 0; m < 8; m++) {
        if (m0 + m < M) {
          const uint4 xq =
              reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(x + (size_t)(m0 + m) * ldx)[i];
          const half2* xh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&xq);
#pragma unroll
          for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
            const half2* wh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wq[u][r]);
            float a = acc[r][m];
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[0], xh[0], a, false);
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[1], xh[1], a, false);
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[2], xh[2], a, false);
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[3], xh[3], a, false);
            acc[r][m] = a;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Sum 32 per-lane values over the wave in 31 shuffles; lane L returns the
// total of value L (here acc[L / 8][L % 8]).
__device__ __forceinline__ float wave_transpose_sum(float (&acc)[4][8],
                                                    int lane) {
  float v[32];
#pragma unroll
  for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
#pragma unroll
    for (int m = 0; m < 8; m++) v[r * 8 + m] = acc[r][m];
#pragma unroll
  for (int half_n = 16; half_n >= 1; half_n >>= 1) {
    const bool up = (lane & half_n) != 0;
#pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < half_n; i++) {
      const float send = up ? v[i] : v[i + half_n];
      const float keep = up ? v[i + half_n] : v[i];
      v[i] = keep + __shfl_xor(send, half_n);
    }
  }
  return v[0];
}

__device__ __forceinline__ void zero48(float (&acc)[4][8]) {
#pragma unroll
  for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
#pragma unroll
    for (int m = 0; m < 8; m++) acc[r][m] = 0.f;
}

#ifndef MONO_FFN_P2_ROWS4  // HC down / up GEMVs at M <= 8 on 4-row wave tasks
  #define MONO_FFN_P2_ROWS4 0
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_P3_ROWS4
  #define MONO_FFN_P3_ROWS4 0
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_E1A
  #define MONO_FFN_E1A 0
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_ROWU
  #define MONO_FFN_ROWU 4  // row_dot weight loads in flight per lane
#endif
// Today's decode GEMV loop (RowF16::dot in rdna_fused_glue.cu), K range
// [k8_lo, k8_hi): one weight row per wave, lanes stride K, 4 loads in flight.
template <int MT>
__device__ __forceinline__ void row_dot(const half* __restrict__ w,
                                        const half* __restrict__ x, int ldx,
                                        int M, int k8_lo, int k8_hi, int lane,
                                        float (&acc)[MT]) {
  const uint4* wr = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(w);
  constexpr int RU = MONO_FFN_ROWU;
  for (int i = k8_lo + lane; i < k8_hi; i += 32 * RU) {
    uint4 wq[RU];
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < RU; u++) {
      const int idx = i + 32 * u;
      wq[u] = idx < k8_hi ? wr[idx] : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < RU; u++) {
      const int idx = i + 32 * u;
      if (idx < k8_hi) {
        const half2* wh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wq[u]);
#pragma unroll
        for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) {
          if (m < M) {
            const uint4 xq =
                reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(x + (size_t)m * ldx)[idx];
            const half2* xh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&xq);
            float a = acc[m];
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[0], xh[0], a, false);
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[1], xh[1], a, false);
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[2], xh[2], a, false);
            a = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[3], xh[3], a, false);
            acc[m] = a;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Two weight rows per wave (w0, w0 + K): twice the weight loads in flight per
// lane, and every activation load serves both rows. acc[0][m], acc[1][m].
template <int MT>
__device__ __forceinline__ void row_dot2(const half* __restrict__ w,
                                         const half* __restrict__ x, int ldx,
                                         int K, int M, int k8_lo, int k8_hi,
                                         int lane, float (&acc)[2][MT]) {
  const uint4* w0 = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(w);
  const uint4* w1 = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(w + K);
  for (int i = k8_lo + lane; i < k8_hi; i += 32 * 4) {
    uint4 wa[4], wb[4];
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < 4; u++) {
      const int idx = i + 32 * u;
      wa[u] = idx < k8_hi ? w0[idx] : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
      wb[u] = idx < k8_hi ? w1[idx] : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < 4; u++) {
      const int idx = i + 32 * u;
      if (idx < k8_hi) {
        const half2* ha = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wa[u]);
        const half2* hb = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wb[u]);
#pragma unroll
        for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) {
          if (m < M) {
            const uint4 xq =
                reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(x + (size_t)m * ldx)[idx];
            const half2* xh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&xq);
            float a0 = acc[0][m], a1 = acc[1][m];
#pragma unroll
            for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
              a0 = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(ha[q], xh[q], a0, false);
              a1 = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(hb[q], xh[q], a1, false);
            }
            acc[0][m] = a0;
            acc[1][m] = a1;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// One WG computes a BM x BN tile of A . B^T over k in [kb, ke) (32-element
// slabs, next slab prefetched into registers while the current one is used).
// Port of gemm_tn_splitk_k / hc_up_mix_prefill_k (hc_prefill_rdna2.cu), the
// kernels today's M > 8 path runs, re-shaped for 256 threads (TX x TY) and
// one 32-row M tile. LDS layout is theirs: k-pair-major half2, A read with one
// vector load per thread (TM = 2 or 4), B broadcast across the TY rows.
// aload(r, k) -> 8 halfs of A row r at k (zero for r >= M); brow(n) -> row n
// of B (K-contiguous). acc[i][j] is (row ty*TM + i, col tx*NC + j).
template <int TX, int TY, int TM, int NC, typename AL, typename BR>
__device__ __forceinline__ void wg_tile_tn(AL aload, BR brow, int kb, int ke,
                                           half2* lds, float (&acc)[TM][NC]) {
  constexpr int KP = 16;  // k pairs per 32-element slab
  constexpr int BM = TY * TM, BN = TX * NC;
  constexpr int SA = BM + 4, SB = BN + 2;
  constexpr int NT = TX * TY;
  constexpr int A_LD = (BM * 4 + NT - 1) / NT, B_LD = (BN * 4 + NT - 1) / NT;
  static_assert(NT == kThreads, "256-thread tile");
  half2* As = lds;
  half2* Bs = lds + KP * SA;
  const int t = threadIdx.x, tx = t % TX, ty = t / TX;
  uint4 ra[A_LD], rb[B_LD];
  auto fetch = [&](int k0) {
#pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < A_LD; i++) {
      const int idx = t + NT * i;
      ra[i] = idx < BM * 4 ? aload(idx / 4, k0 + (idx % 4) * 8)
                           : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
#pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < B_LD; i++) {
      const int idx = t + NT * i;
      rb[i] = idx < BN * 4 ? *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(brow(idx / 4) +
                                                             k0 + (idx % 4) * 8)
                           : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
  };
  auto stage = [&]() {
#pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < A_LD; i++) {
      const int idx = t + NT * i;
      if (idx < BM * 4) {
        const half2* hv = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&ra[i]);
#pragma unroll
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++)
          As[((idx % 4) * 4 + q) * SA + idx / 4] = hv[q];
      }
    }
#pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < B_LD; i++) {
      const int idx = t + NT * i;
      if (idx < BN * 4) {
        const half2* hv = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&rb[i]);
#pragma unroll
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++)
          Bs[((idx % 4) * 4 + q) * SB + idx / 4] = hv[q];
      }
    }
  };
  if (kb >= ke) return;
  fetch(kb);
  for (int k0 = kb; k0 < ke; k0 += 32) {
    __syncthreads();
    stage();
    __syncthreads();
    if (k0 + 32 < ke) fetch(k0 + 32);
#pragma unroll
    for (int kp = 0; kp < KP; kp++) {
      half2 a[TM];
      if constexpr (TM == 4) {
        *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(&a[0]) =
            *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(&As[kp * SA + ty * TM]);
      } else {
        *reinterpret_cast<uint2*>(&a[0]) =
            *reinterpret_cast<const uint2*>(&As[kp * SA + ty * TM]);
      }
      half2 b[NC];
#pragma unroll
      for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++) b[j] = Bs[kp * SB + tx * NC + j];
#pragma unroll
      for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++)
#pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++)
          acc[i][j] = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(a[i], b[j], acc[i][j], false);
    }
  }
  __syncthreads();  // LDS free for the caller's next tile
}

// Partial int4 GEMM of one wave: 4 consecutive columns per lane at `col`,
// k8 rows [k8_lo, k8_hi) of a [K/8, N] packed matrix, against nr activation
// rows (x row r at xrow[r], 8 halfs per k8). Adds into acc[r][4].
template <int NR, int U>
__device__ __forceinline__ void q4_cols4(const uint32_t* __restrict__ wq,
                                         const half* __restrict__ sc,
                                         const uint32_t* __restrict__ zq, int N,
                                         int col, int group8, int zoff,
                                         int k8_lo, int k8_hi,
                                         const half* const (&xrow)[NR], int nr,
                                         float (&acc)[NR][4]) {
  if (k8_lo >= k8_hi) return;
  // Fetch the zeros/scales of the slice's first 4 quant groups up front so the
  // group switch does not wait on memory (later groups load on demand).
  constexpr int kMaxG = 4;
  const int g_lo = k8_lo / group8;
  uint32_t zw[kMaxG];
  uint2 sw[kMaxG];
#pragma unroll
  for (int q = 0; q < kMaxG; q++) {
    const int g = min(g_lo + q, (k8_hi - 1) / group8);
    zw[q] = zq[(size_t)g * (N / 8) + col / 8];
    sw[q] = *reinterpret_cast<const uint2*>(sc + (size_t)g * N + col);
  }
  half2 zz[4][2], yy[4][2], s2[4];
  int cur = -1;
  for (int k0 = k8_lo; k0 < k8_hi; k0 += U) {
    uint4 w[U];
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < U; u++)
      w[u] =
          (k0 + u < k8_hi)
              ? *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(wq + (size_t)(k0 + u) * N + col)
              : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
#pragma unroll
    for (int u = 0; u < U; u++) {
      const int k8 = k0 + u;
      if (k8 >= k8_hi) break;
      const int q = k8 / group8 - g_lo;
      if (q != cur) {
        cur = q;
        uint32_t zsel = zw[0];
        uint2 ssel = sw[0];
#pragma unroll
        for (int t = 1; t < kMaxG; t++)
          if (q == t) {
            zsel = zw[t];
            ssel = sw[t];
          }
        if (q >= kMaxG) {  // slices longer than kMaxG groups: load on demand
          const int g = g_lo + q;
          zsel = zq[(size_t)g * (N / 8) + col / 8];
          ssel = *reinterpret_cast<const uint2*>(sc + (size_t)g * N + col);
        }
        const uint32_t d = zsel >> ((col & 7) * 4);
        const half* sh = reinterpret_cast<const half*>(&ssel);
#pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
          vllm::gptq_rdna2::prep_zero_scale_fp16(((d >> (4 * c)) & 0xF) + zoff,
                                                 __float2half_rn(1.0f), zz[c],
                                                 yy[c]);
          s2[c] = __half2half2(sh[c]);
        }
      }
      half2 dq[4][4];
      const uint32_t* wu = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&w[u]);
#pragma unroll
      for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        vllm::gptq_rdna2::dequant_4bit_8_fp16(wu[c], dq[c], zz[c], yy[c]);
#pragma unroll
        for (int jj = 0; jj < 4; jj++) dq[c][jj] = __hmul2(dq[c][jj], s2[c]);
      }
#pragma unroll
      for (int r = 0; r < NR; r++) {
        if (r < nr) {
          const uint4 xq = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(xrow[r])[k8];
          const half2* xh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&xq);
#pragma unroll
          for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
            float v = acc[r][c];
            v = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(dq[c][0], xh[0], v, false);
            v = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(dq[c][1], xh[1], v, false);
            v = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(dq[c][2], xh[2], v, false);
            v = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(dq[c][3], xh[3], v, false);
            acc[r][c] = v;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// One WG task of the tiled routed GEMMs (today's moe_gemm_q4 decomposition):
// 256 threads x 4 contiguous columns from n0, K8 rows [klo, khi), for `rows`
// activation rows of one expert. The rows' K slice is staged in LDS (s_x,
// NR x (khi - klo) x 8 halfs) once per chunk of NR rows, so the inner loop only
// issues weight loads. emit(r, col, a[4]) consumes row r's partial sums.
template <int NR, int U, typename RowOf, typename Emit>
__device__ __forceinline__ void tiled_q4(const uint32_t* __restrict__ wq,
                                         const half* __restrict__ sc,
                                         const uint32_t* __restrict__ zq, int N,
                                         int group8, int zoff, int n0, int klo,
                                         int khi, int rows, RowOf row_of,
                                         half* s_x, Emit emit) {
  const int tid = threadIdx.x;
  const int col = n0 + tid * 4;
  const int kl8 = khi - klo;
  for (int r0 = 0; r0 < rows; r0 += NR) {
    const int nr = min(NR, rows - r0);
    for (int i = tid; i < nr * kl8; i += kThreads) {
      const int r = i / kl8, k = i % kl8;
      reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(s_x + (size_t)r * kl8 * 8)[k] =
          reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(row_of(r0 + r))[klo + k];
    }
    __syncthreads();
    if (col < N) {
      const half* xrow[NR];
#pragma unroll
      for (int r = 0; r < NR; r++)
        xrow[r] = s_x + (size_t)(r < nr ? r : 0) * kl8 * 8 - (size_t)klo * 8;
      float a[NR][4];
#pragma unroll
      for (int r = 0; r < NR; r++)
#pragma unroll
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) a[r][q] = 0.f;
      q4_cols4<NR, U>(wq, sc, zq, N, col, group8, zoff, klo, khi, xrow, nr, a);
#pragma unroll
      for (int r = 0; r < NR; r++)
        if (r < nr) emit(r0 + r, col, a[r]);
    }
    __syncthreads();
  }
}

// K slice (in K8 rows, a multiple of kTK8 up to kmax) for the tiled tasks:
// minimize rounds over the grid x (slice + fixed cost).
__device__ __forceinline__ int tiled_kslice(int base, int K8, int kmax,
                                            int units, int ovh) {
  constexpr int kTK8 = 32;
  int best = 0x7fffffff, kp = kTK8;
  for (int k = kTK8; k <= max(kTK8, min(kmax, K8)); k += kTK8) {
    const int nk = (K8 + k - 1) / k;
    const int rounds = (base * nk + units - 1) / units;
    const int sc = rounds * (k + ovh);
    if (sc < best) {
      best = sc;
      kp = k;
    }
  }
  return kp;
}

// Dense MTP expert dot products keep checkpoint row-major weights. Each wave
// owns one output row and reduces K; the same weight vector is reused across
// four routed token rows before loading the next vector.
template <int MT, typename RowOf>
__device__ __forceinline__ void dense_dot_rows(const half* __restrict__ w,
                                               int K, RowOf row_of, int rows,
                                               int lane, float (&acc)[MT]) {
  const uint4* wr = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(w);
#pragma unroll
  for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) acc[m] = 0.f;
  for (int k = lane * 8; k < K; k += 32 * 8) {
    const uint4 wq = wr[k / 8];
    const half2* wh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wq);
#pragma unroll
    for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) {
      if (m < rows) {
        const uint4 xq = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(row_of(m))[k / 8];
        const half2* xh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&xq);
        float v = acc[m];
#pragma unroll
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++)
          v = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(wh[q], xh[q], v, false);
        acc[m] = v;
      }
    }
  }
  wave_sum<MT>(acc);
}

template <int MT, typename RowOf>
__device__ __forceinline__ void dense_dot2_rows(const half* __restrict__ wg,
                                                const half* __restrict__ wu,
                                                int K, RowOf row_of, int rows,
                                                int lane, float (&g)[MT],
                                                float (&u)[MT]) {
  const uint4* wgp = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(wg);
  const uint4* wup = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(wu);
#pragma unroll
  for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) g[m] = u[m] = 0.f;
  for (int k = lane * 8; k < K; k += 32 * 8) {
    const uint4 wgq = wgp[k / 8], wuq = wup[k / 8];
    const half2* gh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wgq);
    const half2* uh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&wuq);
#pragma unroll
    for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) {
      if (m < rows) {
        const uint4 xq = reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(row_of(m))[k / 8];
        const half2* xh = reinterpret_cast<const half2*>(&xq);
        float gv = g[m], uv = u[m];
#pragma unroll
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
          gv = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(gh[q], xh[q], gv, false);
          uv = __builtin_amdgcn_fdot2(uh[q], xh[q], uv, false);
        }
        g[m] = gv;
        u[m] = uv;
      }
    }
  }
  wave_sum<MT>(g);
  wave_sum<MT>(u);
}

// Match native dense HIP rounding: gu is dead after P5c's existing
// phase5 barrier and is reused as [pair,H] half slots in P6. Each P7 thread
// owns one(m,h), so only it consumes/clears all10 slots for that output.
__device__ __forceinline__ half
dense_native_output_rounding(const Params& p, const int* selected_ids, int i) {
  static_assert(sizeof(Fx) * 2 * 640 >= sizeof(half) * 2560,
                "dense [pair,H] slots must fit existing [pair,2I] Fx scratch");
  const int m = i / p.H, h = i % p.H;
  half* const slots = reinterpret_cast<half*>(p.gu);
  float routed = 0.f;
#pragma unroll
  for (int k = 0; k < kTopK; ++k) {
    const int pi = m * kTopK + k;
    const int le = selected_ids[pi] - p.expert_base;
    const size_t address = (size_t)pi * p.H + h;
    if (le >= 0 && le < kLocalE) routed += __half2float(slots[address]);
    // Consume/clear only this exact pair-column, including nonlocal slots.
    slots[address] = __float2half_rn(0.f);
  }
  const half routed16 = __float2half_rn(routed);
  const half shared16 = __float2half_rn(p.acc[i]);
  return __float2half_rn(__half2float(shared16) + __half2float(routed16));
}

// int4 column dequant constants for one (expert, group, column).
__device__ __forceinline__ void q4_prep(const uint32_t* z, const half* s,
                                        int group, int N, int col, int zoff,
                                        half2 (&zz)[2], half2 (&yy)[2],
                                        half2& sc) {
  const uint32_t zw = z[(size_t)group * (N / 8) + col / 8];
  const uint32_t zero = (zw >> ((col & 7) * 4)) & 0xF;
  vllm::gptq_rdna2::prep_zero_scale_fp16(zero + zoff, __float2half_rn(1.0f), zz,
                                         yy);
  sc = __half2half2(s[(size_t)group * N + col]);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ kernel
#ifndef MONO_FFN_MIN_BLOCKS
  #define MONO_FFN_MIN_BLOCKS 1
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_TILED_BIG
  #define MONO_FFN_TILED_BIG 0
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_TILE_MIN
  #define MONO_FFN_TILE_MIN \
    5  // row bucket from which the HC / router GEMVs use LDS tiles
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_TILE_HC
  #define MONO_FFN_TILE_HC 1
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_TILED_WPE
  #define MONO_FFN_TILED_WPE 4  // waves per SIMD the tiled variant is built for
#endif
// MT <= 8: today's per-row GEMV loops, <= 128 VGPRs, two WGs (16 waves) per
// CU. MT > 8: 4x8 register-tiled GEMVs, one WG per CU (MONO_FFN_MIN_BLOCKS).
template <int MT, int WPE>
__global__ void __launch_bounds__(kThreads)
    __attribute__((amdgpu_waves_per_eu(WPE, 16)))
    mono_ffn_kernel(const Params p) {
  // Row path: today's per-row GEMV loops on chunks of <= 8 activation rows,
  // <= 128 VGPRs, two WGs (16 waves) per CU. Tiled path (MONO_FFN_TILED_BIG
  // for MT > 8): 4x8 register tiles, one WG per CU.
  constexpr bool kRow = MT <= 8 || !MONO_FFN_TILED_BIG;
  constexpr int MC = MT < 8 ? MT : 8;       // activation rows per pass
  constexpr int NR = kRow ? 4 : kRowChunk;  // expert rows per pass
#ifndef MONO_FFN_GTOPK_MIN
  #define MONO_FFN_GTOPK_MIN \
    8  // rows above which top-k runs one row per grid wave
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_P5T_OVH
  #define MONO_FFN_P5T_OVH 16
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_P6T_OVH
  #define MONO_FFN_P6T_OVH 16
#endif
#ifndef MONO_FFN_UNR
  #define MONO_FFN_UNR 4
#endif
  constexpr int UNR = MONO_FFN_UNR;  // int4 rows in flight
  // M > 8: the HC GEMVs run as LDS-tiled WG tasks (today's M > 8 kernels).
  constexpr bool kTileHC = MT >= MONO_FFN_TILE_MIN && MONO_FFN_TILE_HC;
  __shared__ int s_flag;
  __shared__ float s_red[kWaves];
  __shared__ half s_lora[kMaxM * 320];  // P3 lora; reused as the P5 SE act
  __shared__ int s_tid[kMaxPairs];
  __shared__ float s_tw[kMaxPairs];
  __shared__ int s_used[kLocalE];            // used-expert slot -> local expert
  __shared__ int s_ucnt[kLocalE];            // rows per used expert
  __shared__ int s_slot[kLocalE];            // local expert -> used slot (-1)
  __shared__ short s_urow[kLocalE * kMaxM];  // pair ids per used expert
  __shared__ int s_nused;
  half* const s_seact = s_lora;  // shared-expert activation (P5), M x Ise

  const int tid = threadIdx.x, lane = tid & 31, wave = tid >> 5;
  const int G = gridDim.x, wg = blockIdx.x;
  const int gw = wg * kWaves + wave, GW = G * kWaves;
  const int M = p.M, H = p.H, HCH = kHC * p.H, R = p.R, ND = p.ND;
  const bool dense_native_rounding = p.dense_mtp && H == 2560 && p.I == 640;

  if (err_set(p.ctrl)) {  // fail-stop: a previous launch timed out
    poison_outputs(p, wg, tid, G);
    return;
  }
  unsigned long long* const sc =
      p.stats ? p.stats + kStatRows * kStatCols : nullptr;
  const bool timing = sc && sc[3] != 0;
  if (timing && tid == 0) {
    const unsigned long long t = wall_clock64();
    atomicMin(&sc[0], t);
    atomicMax(&sc[1], t);
  }
  if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) {
    p.ctrl->ts[0] = wall_clock64();
    p.ctrl->pad[0] = G;  // grid actually launched
  }

  // ---------------- P1: combine + grouped RMSNorm; zero scratch
  if (dense_native_rounding) {
    // Full capacity, not only active M: recover gu lifetime after a dense
    // reset.
    for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < kMaxM * kTopK * 2 * p.I;
         i += G * kThreads)
      p.gu[i].v = 0;
  }
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * ND; i += G * kThreads)
    p.dai[i] = 0.f;
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * H; i += G * kThreads)
    p.acc[i] = 0.f;
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * p.E; i += G * kThreads)
    p.logits[i] = 0.f;
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * 2 * p.Ise; i += G * kThreads)
    p.se_g[i] = 0.f;
  for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M; i += G * kThreads)
    p.se_gate[i] = 0.f;
  if (p.gdn && wg == 0 && tid < 4) p.ctrl->gwork[tid] = 0;
  for (int item = wg; item < M * kHC; item += G) {
    const int m = item / kHC, c = item % kHC;
    const float injc = 2.f * sigmoid_f(__half2float(p.inj[m * kHC + c]) / kHC);
    const half* rr = p.res + (size_t)m * HCH + c * H;
    const half* bb = p.blk + (size_t)m * H;
    half* ro = p.res_out + (size_t)m * HCH + c * H;
    float ss = 0.f;
    for (int h = tid; h < H; h += kThreads) {
      const half o =
          __float2half(__half2float(rr[h]) + __half2float(bb[h]) * injc);
      ro[h] = o;
      const float of = __half2float(o);
      ss += of * of;
    }
    for (int off = 16; off >= 1; off >>= 1) ss += __shfl_xor(ss, off);
    if (lane == 0) s_red[wave] = ss;
    __syncthreads();
    float tot = 0.f;
#pragma unroll
    for (int w = 0; w < kWaves; w++) tot += s_red[w];
    const float rrms = rsqrtf(tot / H + p.eps);
    const half* nw = p.norm_w + c * H;
    half* xo = p.xn + (size_t)m * HCH + c * H;
    for (int h = tid; h < H; h += kThreads) {
      float y = __half2float(ro[h]) * rrms;
      y += y * __half2float(nw[h]);
      xo[h] = __float2half(y);
    }
    __syncthreads();
  }
  {
    const int K8 = HCH / 8, NG = (ND + 3) / 4;
    const int ksplit = max(1, (2 * GW + NG - 1) / NG);
    const int chunk = (K8 + ksplit - 1) / ksplit;
    auto pf = [&](int tt, uint32_t& sink, const volatile int* rel) {
      for (int w8 = 0; w8 < kWaves; w8++)
        for (int t = wg * kWaves + w8; t < NG * ksplit; t += GW) {
          const int g = t % NG, sidx = t / NG;
          const int lo = sidx * chunk, hi = min(K8, lo + chunk);
          for (int r = 0; r < min(4, ND - 4 * g); r++)
            touch16(p.wd + (size_t)(4 * g + r) * HCH + lo * 8, hi - lo, tt,
                    sink, rel);
        }
    };
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 1, &s_flag, pf)) return;
  }
  if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[1] = wall_clock64();

  // ---------------- P2: HC down+inject GEMV
  if constexpr (kTileHC) {  // 32 x 64 LDS tiles, K split, fp32 atomics
    constexpr int TX = 32, TY = 8, TM = MT <= 16 ? 2 : 4, NC = 2, BN = TX * NC;
    const int nblk = (ND + BN - 1) / BN;
    const int splits = max(1, min(64, (2 * G + nblk - 1) / nblk));
    const int kps = ((HCH + splits - 1) / splits + 31) / 32 * 32;
    const int nsplit = (HCH + kps - 1) / kps;
    for (int t = wg; t < nblk * nsplit; t += G) {
      const int n0 = (t % nblk) * BN, kb = (t / nblk) * kps;
      float acc[TM][NC];
#pragma unroll
      for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++)
#pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++) acc[i][j] = 0.f;
      wg_tile_tn<TX, TY, TM, NC>(
          [&](int r, int k) {
            return r < M ? *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(p.xn +
                                                           (size_t)r * HCH + k)
                         : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
          },
          [&](int n) { return p.wd + (size_t)min(n0 + n, ND - 1) * HCH; }, kb,
          min(HCH, kb + kps), reinterpret_cast<half2*>(s_lora), acc);
      const int tx = tid % TX, ty = tid / TX;
#pragma unroll
      for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++) {
        const int row = ty * TM + i;
        if (row >= M) continue;
#pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++) {
          const int col = n0 + tx * NC + j;
          if (col < ND) atomicAdd(&p.dai[row * ND + col], acc[i][j]);
        }
      }
    }
  } else if constexpr (kRow && !MONO_FFN_P2_ROWS4) {  // wave per row, K split,
                                                      // fp32 atomics
    const int K8 = HCH / 8;
    const int ksplit = max(1, (2 * GW + ND - 1) / ND);
    const int chunk = (K8 + ksplit - 1) / ksplit;
    for (int t = gw; t < ND * ksplit; t += GW) {
      const int r = t % ND, sidx = t / ND;
      const int lo = sidx * chunk, hi = min(K8, lo + chunk);
      for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += MC) {
        float a[MC];
#pragma unroll
        for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++) a[m] = 0.f;
        row_dot<MC>(p.wd + (size_t)r * HCH, p.xn + (size_t)m0 * HCH, HCH,
                    M - m0, lo, hi, lane, a);
        wave_sum<MC>(a);
        if (lane == 0) {
#pragma unroll
          for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++)
            if (m0 + m < M) atomicAdd(&p.dai[(m0 + m) * ND + r], a[m]);
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    const int K8 = HCH / 8, NG = (ND + 3) / 4;
    const int ksplit = max(1, (2 * GW + NG - 1) / NG);
    const int chunk = (K8 + ksplit - 1) / ksplit;
    for (int t = gw; t < NG * ksplit; t += GW) {
      const int g = t % NG, sidx = t / NG;
      const int lo = sidx * chunk, hi = min(K8, lo + chunk);
      const int nw = min(4, ND - 4 * g);
      const half* w[4];
#pragma unroll
      for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
        w[r] = p.wd + (size_t)min(4 * g + r, ND - 1) * HCH;
      for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += 8) {
        float acc[4][8];
        zero48(acc);
        rows4_dot(w, nw, p.xn, HCH, m0, M, lo, hi, lane, acc);
        const float v = wave_transpose_sum(acc, lane);
        const int r = lane / 8, m = m0 + lane % 8;
        if (r < nw && m < M) atomicAdd(&p.dai[m * ND + 4 * g + r], v);
      }
    }
  }
  {
    auto pf = [&](int tt, uint32_t& sink, const volatile int* rel) {
      for (int w8 = 0; w8 < kWaves; w8++)
        for (int h = wg * kWaves + w8; h < H; h += GW)
          for (int c = 0; c < kHC; c++)
            touch16(p.wu + (size_t)(c * H + h) * R, R / 8, tt, sink, rel);
    };
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 2, &s_flag, pf)) return;
  }
  if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[2] = wall_clock64();

  // ---------------- P3: HC up GEMV + sigmoid + gated mean -> block_input.
  // One wave task per h: the 4 rows c*H + h share every lora load.
  if constexpr (!kTileHC) {
    for (int i = tid; i < M * R; i += kThreads) {
      const int m = i / R, r = i % R;
      s_lora[i] = __float2half(silu_f(p.dai[m * ND + r] * (1.f / kHC)));
    }
  }
  if (wg == 0 && tid < M * kHC)
    p.inj_out[tid] = __float2half(p.dai[(tid / kHC) * ND + R + tid % kHC]);
  __syncthreads();
  if constexpr (kTileHC) {  // hc_up_mix_prefill_k: 32 rows x 16 h x 4 streams
    constexpr int TX = 16, TY = 16, TM = 2, NC = kHC;
    for (int t = wg; t < H / TX; t += G) {
      const int h0 = t * TX;
      float acc[TM][NC];
#pragma unroll
      for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++)
#pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++) acc[i][j] = 0.f;
      wg_tile_tn<TX, TY, TM, NC>(
          [&](int r, int k) {  // lora = fp16(silu(dai / HC)), staged on the fly
            uint4 v = make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
            if (r < M) {
              half2* hv = reinterpret_cast<half2*>(&v);
              const Fx* d = p.dai + r * ND + k;
#pragma unroll
              for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++)
                hv[q] = __floats2half2_rn(silu_f(d[2 * q] * (1.f / kHC)),
                                          silu_f(d[2 * q + 1] * (1.f / kHC)));
            }
            return v;
          },
          [&](int n) {
            return p.wu + (size_t)((n % kHC) * H + h0 + n / kHC) * R;
          },
          0, R, reinterpret_cast<half2*>(s_lora), acc);
      const int tx = tid % TX, ty = tid / TX, h = h0 + tx;
#pragma unroll
      for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++) {
        const int row = ty * TM + i;
        if (row >= M) continue;
        float mix = 0.f;
#pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < kHC;
             c++) {  // the M > 8 path rounds the gate to fp16
          const float g = __half2float(__float2half(acc[i][c]));
          mix +=
              sigmoid_f(g) * __half2float(p.xn[(size_t)row * HCH + c * H + h]);
        }
        p.bin[(size_t)row * H + h] = __float2half(mix * (1.f / kHC));
      }
    }
  } else if constexpr (kRow &&
                       !MONO_FFN_P3_ROWS4) {  // today's hc_up_gate_mix_k loop,
                                              // wave per h
    for (int h = gw; h < H; h += GW) {
      for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += MC) {
        float mix[MC];
#pragma unroll
        for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++) mix[m] = 0.f;
#pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < kHC; c++) {
          float a[MC];
#pragma unroll
          for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++) a[m] = 0.f;
          row_dot<MC>(p.wu + (size_t)(c * H + h) * R, s_lora + m0 * R, R,
                      M - m0, 0, R / 8, lane, a);
          wave_sum<MC>(a);
#pragma unroll
          for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++)
            if (m0 + m < M)
              mix[m] += sigmoid_f(a[m]) *
                        __half2float(p.xn[(size_t)(m0 + m) * HCH + c * H + h]);
        }
        if (lane == 0) {
#pragma unroll
          for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++)
            if (m0 + m < M)
              p.bin[(size_t)(m0 + m) * H + h] = __float2half(mix[m] / kHC);
        }
      }
    }
  } else
    for (int h = gw; h < H; h += GW) {
      const half* w[4];
#pragma unroll
      for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) w[c] = p.wu + (size_t)(c * H + h) * R;
      for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += 8) {
        const int c = lane / 8, m = m0 + lane % 8;
        const float xv =
            m < M ? __half2float(p.xn[(size_t)m * HCH + c * H + h]) : 0.f;
        float acc[4][8];
        zero48(acc);
        rows4_dot(w, 4, s_lora, R, m0, M, 0, R / 8, lane, acc);
        float v = wave_transpose_sum(acc, lane);
        v = (m < M) ? sigmoid_f(v) * xv : 0.f;
        v += __shfl_xor(v, 8);
        v += __shfl_xor(v, 16);
        if (lane < 8 && m < M) p.bin[(size_t)m * H + h] = __float2half(v / kHC);
      }
    }
  {
    const int K8 = H / 8;
    const int NR = (p.E + 3) / 4, NS = p.Ise / 2, NT = NR + NS + 1;
    const int ksplit = max(1, GW / NT);
    const int chunk = (K8 + ksplit - 1) / ksplit;
    auto pf = [&](int tt, uint32_t& sink, const volatile int* rel) {
      for (int w8 = 0; w8 < kWaves; w8++)
        for (int t = wg * kWaves + w8; t < NT * ksplit; t += GW) {
          const int g = t % NT, sidx = t / NT;
          const int lo = sidx * chunk, hi = min(K8, lo + chunk);
          if (g < NR) {
            for (int r = 0; r < min(4, p.E - 4 * g); r++)
              touch16(p.wr + (size_t)(4 * g + r) * H + lo * 8, hi - lo, tt,
                      sink, rel);
          } else if (g < NR + NS) {
            const int i0 = 2 * (g - NR);
            const int rr[4] = {i0, i0 + 1, p.Ise + i0, p.Ise + i0 + 1};
            for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
              touch16(p.se_w1 + (size_t)rr[r] * H + lo * 8, hi - lo, tt, sink,
                      rel);
          }
        }
    };
    if (p.hc_only) return;  // K1: kernel end orders the outputs
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 3, &s_flag, pf)) return;
  }
  if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[3] = wall_clock64();

#if MONO_FFN_E1A  // E1a GDN mode (reference only; off: it costs the FFN path
                  // ~25%)
  if (p.gdn) {
    // fp16 GEMV out[m, col0 + n] = W[n, :] . X[m, :]: two output rows per wave
    // over the whole K, all M rows in one pass (row_dot2).
    auto gemv_fx = [&](const half* W, int NRows, int K, const half* X, Fx* out,
                       int ldo, int col0, int ctr) {
      const int K8 = K / 8;
      (void)ctr;
      for (int r = 2 * gw; r < NRows; r += 2 * GW) {  // NRows is even
        float a[2][MT];
  #pragma unroll
        for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++) a[0][m] = a[1][m] = 0.f;
        row_dot2<MT>(W + (size_t)r * K, X, K, K, M, 0, K8, lane, a);
        wave_sum<MT>(a[0]);
        wave_sum<MT>(a[1]);
        if (lane == 0) {
  #pragma unroll
          for (int m = 0; m < MT; m++)
            if (m < M) {
              out[(size_t)m * ldo + col0 + r] = a[0][m];
              out[(size_t)m * ldo + col0 + r + 1] = a[1][m];
            }
        }
      }
    };
    // ---------------- P4g: in_proj_qkvz | in_proj_ba from block_input
    gemv_fx(p.g_wq, kGdnNQ, H, p.bin, p.g_q, kGdnNI, 0, 0);
    gemv_fx(p.g_wba, kGdnNB, H, p.bin, p.g_q, kGdnNI, kGdnNQ, 1);
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 4, &s_flag)) return;
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[4] = wall_clock64();

    // ---------------- P5g: one WG per (row, value head): causal conv update of
    // the head's q|k|v channels, the gated delta-rule update of its fp32 state
    // (gdn_decode_rdna2's math, 4 tiles of 32 v rows x 8 k slices), gated
    // RMSNorm. Reference rounding: projections, conv output, state readout and
    // norm output in fp16.
    {
      float* sf =
          reinterpret_cast<float*>(s_lora);  // q[128] k[128] v[128] o[128]
      float* sq = sf;
      float* sk = sf + 128;
      float* sv = sf + 256;
      float* so = sf + 384;
      constexpr int REP = kGdnHV / kGdnH;
      const auto hv16 = [&](int m, int c) {  // projected value, fp16-rounded
        return __half2float(__float2half((float)p.g_q[(size_t)m * kGdnNI + c]));
      };
      for (int t = wg; t < M * kGdnHV; t += G) {
        const int m = t / kGdnHV, hv = t % kGdnHV, h = hv / REP;
        const long slot = p.g_sidx[m];
        if (slot <= 0 ||
            slot >= p.g_slots) {  // null / padded row: zero, no state
          for (int i = tid; i < kGdnV; i += kThreads)
            p.g_y[(size_t)m * kGdnVD + hv * kGdnV + i] = __float2half(0.f);
          continue;
        }
        for (int i = tid; i < 3 * 128; i += kThreads) {
          const int seg = i / 128, j = i % 128;
          const int ch = seg == 0   ? h * kGdnK + j
                         : seg == 1 ? kGdnH * kGdnK + h * kGdnK + j
                                    : kGdnQK + hv * kGdnV + j;
          half* cs = p.g_convs + slot * p.g_cs_slot + (long)ch * p.g_cs_dim;
          const float s0 = __half2float(cs[0]);
          const float s1 = __half2float(cs[p.g_cs_t]);
          const float s2 = __half2float(cs[2 * p.g_cs_t]);
          const float x = hv16(m, ch);
          const half* w = p.g_convw + (size_t)ch * 4;
          float acc = __half2float(w[0]) * s0 + __half2float(w[1]) * s1 +
                      __half2float(w[2]) * s2 + __half2float(w[3]) * x;
          if (p.g_convb != nullptr) acc += __half2float(p.g_convb[ch]);
          const float y = __half2float(__float2half(silu_f(acc)));
          sf[seg * 128 + j] = y;
          if (seg == 2) {  // v channels belong to this head only
            cs[0] = __float2half(s1);
            cs[p.g_cs_t] = __float2half(s2);
            cs[2 * p.g_cs_t] = __float2half(x);
          } else if (hv % REP ==
                     0) {  // q|k shared by REP heads: written in P6g
            half* st = p.g_st + ((size_t)m * kGdnQK + ch) * 3;
            st[0] = __float2half(s1);
            st[1] = __float2half(s2);
            st[2] = __float2half(x);
          }
        }
        __syncthreads();
        const int v_local = tid >> 3, ks = tid & 7, k0 = ks * 16;
        float q[16], kk[16];
  #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
          q[j] = sq[k0 + j];
          kk[j] = sk[k0 + j];
        }
        float nq = 0.f, nk = 0.f;
  #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
          nq += q[j] * q[j];
          nk += kk[j] * kk[j];
        }
        for (int off = 1; off <= 4; off <<= 1) {
          nq += __shfl_xor(nq, off);
          nk += __shfl_xor(nk, off);
        }
        const float q_scale = p.g_scale / sqrtf(nq + 1e-6f);
        const float k_scale = 1.0f / sqrtf(nk + 1e-6f);
  #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
          q[j] *= q_scale;
          kk[j] *= k_scale;
        }
        const float a_val = hv16(m, kGdnNQ + kGdnHV + hv);
        const float b_val = hv16(m, kGdnNQ + hv);
        const float xg = a_val + p.g_dtb[hv];
        const float softplus = xg <= 20.f ? logf(1.f + expf(xg)) : xg;
        const float decay = expf(-expf(p.g_alog[hv]) * softplus);
        const float beta =
            __half2float(__float2half(1.f / (1.f + expf(-b_val))));
        for (int it = 0; it < kGdnV / 32; it++) {
          const int o_v = it * 32 + v_local;
          float* ph = p.g_ssm + slot * p.g_ss_slot +
                      ((long)hv * kGdnV + o_v) * kGdnK + k0;
          float hs[16];
  #pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) hs[j] = ph[j] * decay;
          float acc = 0.f;
  #pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) acc += hs[j] * kk[j];
          for (int off = 1; off <= 4; off <<= 1) acc += __shfl_xor(acc, off);
          const float v2 = (sv[o_v] - acc) * beta;
  #pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) hs[j] += v2 * kk[j];
          float oa = 0.f;
  #pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) oa += hs[j] * q[j];
          for (int off = 1; off <= 4; off <<= 1) oa += __shfl_xor(oa, off);
  #pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) ph[j] = hs[j];
          if (ks == 0) so[o_v] = __half2float(__float2half(oa));
        }
        __syncthreads();
        // gated RMSNorm over the head (norm before gate)
        float ss = 0.f;
        for (int i = tid; i < kGdnV; i += kThreads) ss += so[i] * so[i];
        for (int off = 16; off >= 1; off >>= 1) ss += __shfl_xor(ss, off);
        if (lane == 0) s_red[wave] = ss;
        __syncthreads();
        float tot = 0.f;
  #pragma unroll
        for (int w8 = 0; w8 < kWaves; w8++) tot += s_red[w8];
        const float rstd = rsqrtf(tot / kGdnV + p.g_eps);
        for (int i = tid; i < kGdnV; i += kThreads) {
          const float zv = hv16(m, kGdnCD + hv * kGdnV + i);
          const float sg = 1.f / (1.f + expf(-zv));
          const float gate = p.g_sig ? sg : zv * sg;
          p.g_y[(size_t)m * kGdnVD + hv * kGdnV + i] =
              __float2half(so[i] * rstd * __half2float(p.g_normw[i]) * gate);
        }
        __syncthreads();
      }
    }
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 5, &s_flag)) return;
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[5] = wall_clock64();

    // ---------------- P6g: out_proj (rank partial) + deferred q|k conv state
    gemv_fx(p.g_wo, H, kGdnVD, p.g_y, p.acc, H, 0, 2);
    for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * kGdnQK * 3; i += G * kThreads) {
      const int m = i / (kGdnQK * 3), r = i % (kGdnQK * 3), ch = r / 3,
                j = r % 3;
      const long slot = p.g_sidx[m];
      if (slot <= 0 || slot >= p.g_slots) continue;
      p.g_convs[slot * p.g_cs_slot + (long)ch * p.g_cs_dim + j * p.g_cs_t] =
          p.g_st[i];
    }
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 6, &s_flag)) return;
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[6] = wall_clock64();
  } else
#endif
  {

    // ---------------- P4: router (fp32 logits), shared-expert gate_up, expert
    // gate; K split, fp32 atomics.
    if constexpr (kTileHC) {  // same 32 x 64 LDS tiles over the E + 2*Ise + 1
                              // rows
      constexpr int TX = 32, TY = 8, TM = MT <= 16 ? 2 : 4, NC = 2,
                    BN = TX * NC;
      const int NTOT = p.E + 2 * p.Ise + 1;
      const int nblk = (NTOT + BN - 1) / BN;
      const int splits = max(1, min(20, (2 * G + nblk - 1) / nblk));
      const int kps = ((H + splits - 1) / splits + 31) / 32 * 32;
      const int nsplit = (H + kps - 1) / kps;
      for (int t = wg; t < nblk * nsplit; t += G) {
        const int n0 = (t % nblk) * BN, kb = (t / nblk) * kps;
        float acc[TM][NC];
#pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++)
#pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++) acc[i][j] = 0.f;
        wg_tile_tn<TX, TY, TM, NC>(
            [&](int r, int k) {
              return r < M ? *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(p.bin +
                                                             (size_t)r * H + k)
                           : make_uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
            },
            [&](int n) {
              const int r = min(n0 + n, NTOT - 1);
              return r < p.E               ? p.wr + (size_t)r * H
                     : r < p.E + 2 * p.Ise ? p.se_w1 + (size_t)(r - p.E) * H
                                           : p.se_wg;
            },
            kb, min(H, kb + kps), reinterpret_cast<half2*>(s_lora), acc);
        const int tx = tid % TX, ty = tid / TX;
#pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < TM; i++) {
          const int m = ty * TM + i;
          if (m >= M) continue;
#pragma unroll
          for (int j = 0; j < NC; j++) {
            const int r = n0 + tx * NC + j;
            if (r < p.E)
              atomicAdd(&p.logits[m * p.E + r], acc[i][j]);
            else if (r < p.E + 2 * p.Ise)
              atomicAdd(&p.se_g[m * 2 * p.Ise + (r - p.E)], acc[i][j]);
            else if (r < NTOT)
              atomicAdd(&p.se_gate[m], acc[i][j]);
          }
        }
      }
    } else if constexpr (kRow) {  // wave per row: E router rows, 2*Ise SE rows,
                                  // 1 gate
      const int K8 = H / 8, NT = p.E + 2 * p.Ise + 1;
      const int ksplit = max(1, GW / NT);
      const int chunk = (K8 + ksplit - 1) / ksplit;
      for (int t = gw; t < NT * ksplit; t += GW) {
        const int r = t % NT, sidx = t / NT;
        const int lo = sidx * chunk, hi = min(K8, lo + chunk);
        const half* w = r < p.E               ? p.wr + (size_t)r * H
                        : r < p.E + 2 * p.Ise ? p.se_w1 + (size_t)(r - p.E) * H
                                              : p.se_wg;
        for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += MC) {
          float a[MC];
#pragma unroll
          for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++) a[m] = 0.f;
          row_dot<MC>(w, p.bin + (size_t)m0 * H, H, M - m0, lo, hi, lane, a);
          wave_sum<MC>(a);
          if (lane == 0) {
#pragma unroll
            for (int mm = 0; mm < MC; mm++) {
              const int m = m0 + mm;
              if (m < M) {
                if (r < p.E)
                  atomicAdd(&p.logits[m * p.E + r], a[mm]);
                else if (r < p.E + 2 * p.Ise)
                  atomicAdd(&p.se_g[m * 2 * p.Ise + (r - p.E)], a[mm]);
                else
                  atomicAdd(&p.se_gate[m], a[mm]);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      const int K8 = H / 8;
      const int NR = (p.E + 3) / 4, NS = p.Ise / 2, NT = NR + NS + 1;
      const int ksplit = max(1, GW / NT);
      const int chunk = (K8 + ksplit - 1) / ksplit;
      for (int t = gw; t < NT * ksplit; t += GW) {
        const int g = t % NT, sidx = t / NT;
        const int lo = sidx * chunk, hi = min(K8, lo + chunk);
        const half* w[4];
        int nw = 4;
        if (g < NR) {
          nw = min(4, p.E - 4 * g);
#pragma unroll
          for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
            w[r] = p.wr + (size_t)min(4 * g + r, p.E - 1) * H;
        } else if (g < NR + NS) {
          const int i0 = 2 * (g - NR);  // gate i0, i0+1 ; up i0, i0+1
          w[0] = p.se_w1 + (size_t)i0 * H;
          w[1] = p.se_w1 + (size_t)(i0 + 1) * H;
          w[2] = p.se_w1 + (size_t)(p.Ise + i0) * H;
          w[3] = p.se_w1 + (size_t)(p.Ise + i0 + 1) * H;
        } else {
          nw = 1;
#pragma unroll
          for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) w[r] = p.se_wg;
        }
        for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += 8) {
          float acc[4][8];
          zero48(acc);
          rows4_dot(w, nw, p.bin, H, m0, M, lo, hi, lane, acc);
          const float v = wave_transpose_sum(acc, lane);
          const int r = lane / 8, m = m0 + lane % 8;
          if (r < nw && m < M) {
            if (g < NR) {
              atomicAdd(&p.logits[m * p.E + 4 * g + r], v);
            } else if (g < NR + NS) {
              const int i0 = 2 * (g - NR);
              const int col = r < 2 ? i0 + r : p.Ise + i0 + (r - 2);
              atomicAdd(&p.se_g[m * 2 * p.Ise + col], v);
            } else {
              atomicAdd(&p.se_gate[m], v);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 4, &s_flag)) return;
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[4] = wall_clock64();

    // ---------------- P5a: top-k (fp32 softmax, renormalized), every WG.
    // Radix select on orderable keys with wave ballots (no cross-lane shuffles
    // per selected expert): T = key of the 10th largest logit; select keys > T
    // plus the lowest-index ties. Slots follow expert index order (the sums are
    // fixed point, so the order of pairs does not change any result).
    // M > GTOPK_MIN: one wave of the grid per row (instead of every WG doing
    // all rows on its 8 waves), published through the workspace + one barrier.
    const bool quantized_router_half_boundary =
        !p.dense_mtp && H == 2560 && p.E == 512 && p.I == 640;
    const bool gtopk = M > MONO_FFN_GTOPK_MIN;
    for (int m = gtopk ? gw : wave; m < M; m += gtopk ? GW : kWaves) {
      int* const o_tid = gtopk ? p.ctrl->topk_id : s_tid;
      float* const o_tw = gtopk ? p.ctrl->topw : s_tw;
      const Fx* lg = p.logits + (size_t)m * p.E;
      float v[16];
      unsigned key[16];
      float mx = -INFINITY;
#pragma unroll
      for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
        const int e = lane + 32 * j;
        v[j] = e < p.E
                   ? ((dense_native_rounding || quantized_router_half_boundary)
                          ? __half2float(__float2half_rn((float)lg[e]))
                          : (float)lg[e])
                   : -INFINITY;
        mx = fmaxf(mx, v[j]);
        const unsigned b = __float_as_uint(v[j]);
        key[j] = e < p.E ? ((b & 0x80000000u) ? ~b : (b | 0x80000000u)) : 0u;
      }
      for (int off = 16; off >= 1; off >>= 1)
        mx = fmaxf(mx, __shfl_xor(mx, off));
      unsigned T = 0;
      for (int bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
        const unsigned cand = T | (1u << bit);
        int cnt = 0;
#pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) cnt += __popcll(__ballot(key[j] >= cand));
        if (cnt >= kTopK) T = cand;
      }
      int gt = 0;
#pragma unroll
      for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) gt += __popcll(__ballot(key[j] > T));
      const int need = kTopK - gt;
      const unsigned long long lt = (1ull << lane) - 1ull;
      int nsel = 0, ntie = 0;
      float sel_sum = 0.f;
#pragma unroll
      for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
        const bool tie = key[j] == T;
        const unsigned long long tb = __ballot(tie);
        const bool sel = key[j] > T || (tie && ntie + __popcll(tb & lt) < need);
        ntie += __popcll(tb);
        const unsigned long long sb = __ballot(sel);
        if (sel) {
          const int slot = nsel + __popcll(sb & lt);
          const float w = __expf(v[j] - mx);
          o_tid[m * kTopK + slot] = lane + 32 * j;
          o_tw[m * kTopK + slot] = w;
          sel_sum += w;
        }
        nsel += __popcll(sb);
      }
      for (int off = 16; off >= 1; off >>= 1)
        sel_sum += __shfl_xor(sel_sum, off);
      __builtin_amdgcn_wave_barrier();
      __builtin_amdgcn_fence(__ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, "agent");
      if (dense_native_rounding) {
        if (lane < kTopK) {
          // Register snapshot before any write; all10 selected lanes remain
          // active for every shuffle. Rank by raw logit, not rounded weights.
          const int id = o_tid[m * kTopK + lane];
          const float weight = o_tw[m * kTopK + lane];
          const float score = __half2float(__float2half_rn((float)lg[id]));
          int rank = 0;
#pragma unroll
          for (int k = 0; k < kTopK; ++k) {
            const float other = __shfl(score, k);
            const int other_id = __shfl(id, k);
            rank += other > score || (other == score && other_id < id);
          }
          o_tid[m * kTopK + rank] = id;
          o_tw[m * kTopK + rank] = weight * (1.f / sel_sum);
        }
      } else {
        if (lane < kTopK) o_tw[m * kTopK + lane] *= 1.f / sel_sum;
      }
    }
    if (gtopk) {
      if (!grid_barrier(p, 7, &s_flag)) return;
      for (int i = tid; i < M * kTopK; i += kThreads) {
        s_tid[i] = __hip_atomic_load(&p.ctrl->topk_id[i], __ATOMIC_RELAXED,
                                     __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
        s_tw[i] = __hip_atomic_load(&p.ctrl->topw[i], __ATOMIC_RELAXED,
                                    __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
      }
      __syncthreads();
    }
    if (tid == 0 && wg < 256)
      p.ctrl->wg_done[8][wg] = wall_clock64();  // top-k done (wave 0)
    for (int e = tid; e < kLocalE; e += kThreads) {
      s_slot[e] = -1;
      s_ucnt[e] = 0;
    }
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0 && wg < 256)
      p.ctrl->wg_done[9][wg] = wall_clock64();  // lists reset
    // local expert lists: mark, prefix over the 128 local experts, then append
    // the pairs with LDS atomics.
    for (int pi = tid; pi < M * kTopK; pi += kThreads) {
      const int le = s_tid[pi] - p.expert_base;
      if (le >= 0 && le < kLocalE) s_slot[le] = 0;
    }
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid < kLocalE) {  // kLocalE = 128 = 4 waves
      const bool used = s_slot[tid] == 0;
      const unsigned long long b = __ballot(used);
      const int rank = __popcll(b & ((1ull << lane) - 1ull));
      if (lane == 0) s_red[wave] = __popcll(b);
      __syncthreads_count(0);
      int off = 0;
      for (int w = 0; w < wave; w++) off += (int)s_red[w];
      if (used) {
        s_slot[tid] = off + rank;
        s_used[off + rank] = tid;
      }
      if (tid == kLocalE - 1) s_nused = off + __popcll(b);
    } else {
      __syncthreads_count(0);
    }
    __syncthreads();
    for (int pi = tid; pi < M * kTopK; pi += kThreads) {
      const int le = s_tid[pi] - p.expert_base;
      if (le >= 0 && le < kLocalE) {
        const int u = s_slot[le];
        const int r = atomicAdd(&s_ucnt[u], 1);
        s_urow[u * kMaxM + r] = (short)pi;
      }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    const int nused = s_nused;
    if (tid == 0 && wg < 256)
      p.ctrl->wg_done[7][wg] = wall_clock64();  // P5a done
    if (wg == 0) {
      for (int i = tid; i < M * kTopK; i += kThreads)
        p.ctrl->topk_id[i] = s_tid[i];
      if (tid == 0) p.ctrl->pad[2] = nused;  // local experts touched (debug)
    }

    // ---------------- P5b: routed gate_up as WG tiles (today's moe_gemm_q4
    // decomposition): (used expert, 1024 contiguous gate|up columns, K slice),
    // activations of the expert's rows staged in LDS, fixed-point partial sums
    // into p.gu; the K slice is chosen so the tiles fill the grid. Then the
    // shared-expert down rows. P5c applies SwiGLU after one more barrier.
    {
      const int I = p.I, N13 = 2 * I, K8 = H / 8, g8 = p.group / 8;
      if (p.dense_mtp) {
        // The checkpoint stores [gate; up] as 2*I rows, but the scratch is
        // packed as [gate(I), up(I)] for each routed pair.
        const int ntile = (I + 7) / 8;
        for (int t = wg; t < nused * ntile; t += G) {
          const int u = t / ntile, nt = t % ntile;
          const int e = s_used[u], col = nt * 8 + wave;
          const half* we = p.w13_dense + (size_t)e * N13 * H;
          for (int r0 = 0; r0 < s_ucnt[u]; r0 += 4) {
            const int nr = min(4, s_ucnt[u] - r0);
            auto row_of = [&](int r) {
              const int pi = s_urow[u * kMaxM + r0 + r];
              return p.bin + (size_t)(pi / kTopK) * H;
            };
            float g[4], up[4];
            dense_dot2_rows<4>(we + (size_t)col * H, we + (size_t)(I + col) * H,
                               H, row_of, nr, lane, g, up);
            if (lane == 0) {
#pragma unroll
              for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
                if (r < nr) {
                  const int pi = s_urow[u * kMaxM + r0 + r];
                  if (dense_native_rounding) {
                    // Keep original FP32 bits without intermediate half/Fx
                    // rounding.
                    p.gu[(size_t)pi * N13 + col].v =
                        (long long)__float_as_uint(g[r]);
                    p.gu[(size_t)pi * N13 + I + col].v =
                        (long long)__float_as_uint(up[r]);
                  } else {
                    p.gu[(size_t)pi * N13 + col] = g[r];
                    p.gu[(size_t)pi * N13 + I + col] = up[r];
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        constexpr int TN = kThreads * 4;
        const int ntile = (N13 + TN - 1) / TN;
        const int tb = nused * ntile;
        const int kp = tiled_kslice(tb, K8, (kMaxM * 320) / (NR * 8) / 32 * 32,
                                    G, MONO_FFN_P5T_OVH);
        const int nk = (K8 + kp - 1) / kp;
        for (int t = wg; t < tb * nk; t += G) {
          const int sidx = t / tb, uc = t % tb;
          const int u = uc / ntile, nt = uc % ntile;
          const int e = s_used[u];
          const int klo = sidx * kp, khi = min(K8, klo + kp);
          tiled_q4<NR, UNR>(
              p.w13 + (size_t)e * K8 * N13,
              p.s13 + (size_t)e * (H / p.group) * N13,
              p.z13 + (size_t)e * (H / p.group) * (N13 / 8), N13, g8,
              p.zero_offset, nt * TN, klo, khi, s_ucnt[u],
              [&](int r) {
                return p.bin + (size_t)(s_urow[u * kMaxM + r] / kTopK) * H;
              },
              s_lora,
              [&](int r, int col, const float (&a)[4]) {
                Fx* dst = p.gu + (size_t)s_urow[u * kMaxM + r] * N13 + col;
#pragma unroll
                for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) atomicAdd(dst + q, a[q]);
              });
        }
      }
      for (int k = tid; k < M * p.Ise; k += kThreads) {
        const int m = k / p.Ise, i2 = k % p.Ise;
        s_seact[k] = __float2half(silu_f(p.se_g[m * 2 * p.Ise + i2]) *
                                  p.se_g[m * 2 * p.Ise + p.Ise + i2]);
      }
      __syncthreads();
      const int Ise8 = p.Ise / 8;
      if constexpr (kRow) {
        for (int h = gw; h < H; h += GW) {
          for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += MC) {
            float a[MC];
#pragma unroll
            for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++) a[m] = 0.f;
            row_dot<MC>(p.se_w2 + (size_t)h * p.Ise, s_seact + m0 * p.Ise,
                        p.Ise, M - m0, 0, Ise8, lane, a);
            wave_sum<MC>(a);
            if (lane == 0) {
#pragma unroll
              for (int m = 0; m < MC; m++)
                if (m0 + m < M)
                  p.acc[(size_t)(m0 + m) * H + h] =
                      a[m] * sigmoid_f(p.se_gate[m0 + m]);
            }
          }
        }
      } else
        for (int g = gw; g < H / 4; g += GW) {
          const half* w[4];
#pragma unroll
          for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
            w[r] = p.se_w2 + (size_t)(4 * g + r) * p.Ise;
          for (int m0 = 0; m0 < M; m0 += 8) {
            float acc[4][8];
            zero48(acc);
            rows4_dot(w, 4, s_seact, p.Ise, m0, M, 0, Ise8, lane, acc);
            const float v = wave_transpose_sum(acc, lane);
            const int r = lane / 8, m = m0 + lane % 8;
            if (m < M)
              p.acc[(size_t)m * H + 4 * g + r] = v * sigmoid_f(p.se_gate[m]);
          }
        }
    }
    {  // P5c: SwiGLU of the routed sums (reference rounding); consume and clear
       // p.gu
      if (!grid_barrier(p, 7, &s_flag)) return;
      const int I = p.I, N13 = 2 * I;
      for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * kTopK * I; i += G * kThreads) {
        const int pi = i / I, j = i % I;
        const int le = s_tid[pi] - p.expert_base;
        if (le < 0 || le >= kLocalE) continue;
        Fx* gp = p.gu + (size_t)pi * N13;
        if (dense_native_rounding) {
          const float gate = __uint_as_float((unsigned)gp[j].v);
          const float up = __uint_as_float((unsigned)gp[I + j].v);
          gp[j].v = 0;
          gp[I + j].v = 0;
          const float activated = gate / (1.0f + expf(-gate));
          p.act[(size_t)pi * I + j] = __float2half_rn(activated * up);
        } else {
          const half g16 = __float2half(gp[j]);
          const half u16 = __float2half(gp[I + j]);
          gp[j].v = 0;
          gp[I + j].v = 0;
          const half sg = __float2half(silu_f(__half2float(g16)));
          p.act[(size_t)pi * I + j] =
              __float2half(__half2float(sg) * __half2float(u16));
        }
      }
    }
    {
      const int I = p.I, K8 = I / 8, nchunk = H / 128;
      auto pf = [&](int tt, uint32_t& sink, const volatile int* rel) {
        for (int t = wg; t < nused * nchunk; t += G) {
          const int u = t / nchunk, c = t % nchunk;
          const uint32_t* wq = p.w2 + (size_t)s_used[u] * K8 * H + c * 128;
          // 80 rows x 512 B: one 16-B unit per (row, 32-column slice)
          for (int i = tt; i < K8 * 32; i += 224) {
            if (*rel) return;
            const uint4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(
                wq + (size_t)(i / 32) * H + (i % 32) * 4);
            sink ^= v.x ^ v.w;
          }
        }
      };
      if (p.dense_mtp) {
        if (!grid_barrier(p, 5, &s_flag)) return;
      } else if (!grid_barrier(p, 5, &s_flag, pf)) {
        return;
      }
    }
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[5] = wall_clock64();

    // ---------------- P6: routed down, same WG tiles over (used expert, 1024
    // output columns, K slice); partials * top-k weight go to the fixed-point
    // acc.
    {
      const int I = p.I, K8 = I / 8, g8 = p.group / 8;
      if (p.dense_mtp) {
        const int ntile = (H + 7) / 8;
        for (int t = wg; t < nused * ntile; t += G) {
          const int u = t / ntile, nt = t % ntile;
          const int e = s_used[u], col = nt * 8 + wave;
          const half* we = p.w2_dense + (size_t)e * H * I + (size_t)col * I;
          for (int r0 = 0; r0 < s_ucnt[u]; r0 += 4) {
            const int nr = min(4, s_ucnt[u] - r0);
            auto row_of = [&](int r) {
              const int pi = s_urow[u * kMaxM + r0 + r];
              return p.act + (size_t)pi * I;
            };
            float a[4];
            dense_dot_rows<4>(we, I, row_of, nr, lane, a);
            if (lane == 0) {
#pragma unroll
              for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
                if (r < nr) {
                  const int pi = s_urow[u * kMaxM + r0 + r];
                  if (dense_native_rounding) {
                    half* const slots = reinterpret_cast<half*>(p.gu);
                    slots[(size_t)pi * H + col] =
                        __float2half_rn(a[r] * s_tw[pi]);
                  } else {
                    Fx* dst = p.acc + (size_t)(pi / kTopK) * H + col;
                    const half down16 = __float2half(a[r]);
                    atomicAdd(dst, __half2float(down16) * s_tw[pi]);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        constexpr int TN = kThreads * 4;
        const int ntile = (H + TN - 1) / TN;
        const int tb = nused * ntile;
        const int kp = tiled_kslice(tb, K8, (kMaxM * 320) / (NR * 8) / 32 * 32,
                                    G, MONO_FFN_P6T_OVH);
        const int nk = (K8 + kp - 1) / kp;
        for (int t = wg; t < tb * nk; t += G) {
          const int sidx = t / tb, uc = t % tb;
          const int u = uc / ntile, nt = uc % ntile;
          const int e = s_used[u];
          const int klo = sidx * kp, khi = min(K8, klo + kp);
          tiled_q4<NR, UNR>(
              p.w2 + (size_t)e * K8 * H, p.s2 + (size_t)e * (I / p.group) * H,
              p.z2 + (size_t)e * (I / p.group) * (H / 8), H, g8, p.zero_offset,
              nt * TN, klo, khi, s_ucnt[u],
              [&](int r) { return p.act + (size_t)s_urow[u * kMaxM + r] * I; },
              s_lora,
              [&](int r, int col, const float (&a)[4]) {
                const int pi = s_urow[u * kMaxM + r];
                const float tw = s_tw[pi];
                Fx* dst = p.acc + (size_t)(pi / kTopK) * H + col;
#pragma unroll
                for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) atomicAdd(dst + q, a[q] * tw);
              });
        }
      }
    }
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 6, &s_flag)) return;
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) p.ctrl->ts[6] = wall_clock64();

  }  // FFN path

  // ---------------- P7: out = fp16(shared + routed) (GDN: out_proj partial)
  if (p.ar_on) {
    // Stage D: rdna_ar one-shot step on its buffers and sequence. Push this
    // rank's fp16 partial into every peer's slot (parity, rank), publish the
    // flag once the whole grid has pushed, wait for the peers' flags, sum the
    // slots in rank order (bitwise the same on every rank, like rdna_ar).
    const int W = p.ar.world, me = p.ar.rank;
    const int seq = __hip_atomic_load(p.ar.seqbuf, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE,
                                      __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT) +
                    1;
    const int par = seq & 1;
    const long long slot = p.ar.max_bytes / 2;
    for (int i = wg * kThreads + tid; i < M * H; i += G * kThreads) {
      const half h = dense_native_rounding
                         ? dense_native_output_rounding(p, s_tid, i)
                         : __float2half(p.acc[i]);
      p.out[i] = h;
      for (int k = 1; k < W; k++) {
        const int j = (me + k) % W;
        reinterpret_cast<half*>(
            p.ar.peers.stage[j])[((long long)par * W + me) * slot + i] = h;
      }
    }
    // one system fence per WG (like rdna_ar), not per thread: a per-thread
    // system fence writes L2 back once per wave
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0) __threadfence_system();
    if (!grid_barrier(p, 7, &s_flag)) return;
    __shared__ int s_ar_ok;
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) {
      __hip_atomic_store(p.ar.seqbuf, seq, __ATOMIC_RELEASE,
                         __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_AGENT);
      for (int j = 0; j < W; j++)
        __hip_atomic_store(&p.ar.peers.flags[j][me], seq, __ATOMIC_RELEASE,
                           __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_SYSTEM);
    }
    // WG0 alone polls the peers' flags; the grid barrier then releases the rest
    if (wg == 0 && tid == 0) {
      int ok = 1;
      const int* mine = p.ar.peers.flags[me];
      const unsigned long long t0 = wall_clock64();
      for (int j = 0; j < W && ok; j++) {
        if (j == me) continue;
        while (__hip_atomic_load(&mine[j], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE,
                                 __HIP_MEMORY_SCOPE_SYSTEM) < seq) {
          __builtin_amdgcn_s_sleep(8);
